description: She wears a burgundy floor-length court gown in substantial opaque patterned fabric, a low square neckline and fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, gold woven borders and geometric embroidery at the neckline, bodice, cuffs and hem, a decorated gold belt with hanging tassels, and a cream embroidered wrap draped over her forearms. Gold earrings, two round shoulder brooches, a small pendant necklace and a ring accompany the gown. A pale underlayer and burgundy flat shoe are visible at the hem. No armor, headgear or weapons are visible.
